name: houjin-bangou
displayName: Japan Corporate & Invoice Check — 法人番号・インボイス照会 (SUGUKURU)
description: MCP App for Japanese National Corporate Number (法人番号 / houjin-bangou) and Qualified Invoice Issuer (適格請求書・インボイス / T-number) lookup & KYB verification using National Tax Agency of Japan public data, with interactive UI cards and company-name normalization.
